{"test_name":"Ledger_2283_Objection2","test_code":"using System;\nusing System.Collections.Immutable;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Analyzers;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Diagnostics;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing Xunit;\n\npublic class Ledger_2283_Objection2\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericValueType_WithKeyedField_GeneratesResolverAndReportsNoErrors()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetMetadataReferencesAsync();\n\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial struct KeyedFieldStruct<T>\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public T Value;\n}\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic partial record struct KeyedFieldRecordStruct<T>([property: Key(0)] string Key)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public T FieldValue;\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"Lib\", libSource, baseReferences);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libAnalyzerDiagnostics = await libCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(libAnalyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(libAnalyzerDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriver libDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        libDriver = libDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(libCompilation, out Compilation libOutputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libGeneratorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult libRunResult = libDriver.GetRunResult();\n        Assert.All(libRunResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(libGeneratorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = EmitToMetadataReference(libOutputCompilation);\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial record Cmd([property: Key(0)] string Scope)\n{\n    [Key(1)]\n    public KeyedFieldStruct<int> FieldStruct { get; init; }\n\n    [Key(2)]\n    public KeyedFieldRecordStruct<string> RecordStruct { get; init; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"App\", appSource, baseReferences.Add(libReference));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appAnalyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appAnalyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(appAnalyzerDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriver appDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        appDriver = appDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out Compilation appOutputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appGeneratorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult appRunResult = appDriver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(appRunResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appGeneratorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            appRunResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        using var appStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var appEmitResult = appOutputCompilation.Emit(appStream);\n        Assert.True(appEmitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, appEmitResult.Diagnostics));\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ClosedGenericValueType_WithNonPropertyMembersAndDiagnostics_InReferencedAssembly_DoesNotCrashOrLeakDiagnostics()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> baseReferences = await GetMetadataReferencesAsync();\n\n        string libSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace Lib;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic struct IndexerStruct<T>\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public T Value;\n\n    [Key(1)]\n    public int this[int index] => index;\n\n    [Key((string)null)]\n    public int this[string key] => 0;\n\n    public int this[long id] => 0;\n}\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic struct UnkeyedFieldStruct<T>\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public T KeyedValue;\n\n    public int UnkeyedField;\n}\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic struct NullKeyPropertyStruct<T>\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public T Value;\n\n    [Key((string)null)]\n    public string NullKeyProp { get; set; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation libCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"LibWithDiagnostics\", libSource, baseReferences);\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> libAnalyzerDiagnostics = await libCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(libAnalyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Contains(\n            libAnalyzerDiagnostics,\n            d => d.Location.IsInSource && libSource.AsSpan(d.Location.SourceSpan.Start, d.Location.SourceSpan.Length).Contains(\"UnkeyedField\".AsSpan(), StringComparison.Ordinal));\n        Assert.Contains(\n            libAnalyzerDiagnostics,\n            d => d.Location.IsInSource && libSource.AsSpan(d.Location.SourceSpan.Start, d.Location.SourceSpan.Length).Contains(\"NullKeyProp\".AsSpan(), StringComparison.Ordinal));\n\n        MetadataReference libReference = EmitToMetadataReference(libCompilation);\n\n        string appSource = \"\"\"\nusing Lib;\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace App;\n\n[MessagePackObject]\npublic sealed partial class Holder\n{\n    [Key(0)]\n    public IndexerStruct<int> IndexerMember { get; set; }\n\n    [Key(1)]\n    public UnkeyedFieldStruct<int> UnkeyedFieldMember { get; set; }\n\n    [Key(2)]\n    public NullKeyPropertyStruct<int> NullKeyPropertyMember { get; set; }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation appCompilation = CreateCompilation(\"App\", appSource, baseReferences.Add(libReference));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appAnalyzerDiagnostics = await appCompilation\n            .WithAnalyzers(ImmutableArray.Create<DiagnosticAnalyzer>(new MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer()))\n            .GetAnalyzerDiagnosticsAsync();\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appAnalyzerDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"AD0001\");\n        Assert.Empty(appAnalyzerDiagnostics);\n\n        GeneratorDriver appDriver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        appDriver = appDriver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(appCompilation, out _, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> appGeneratorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult appRunResult = appDriver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.All(appRunResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n        Assert.DoesNotContain(appGeneratorDiagnostics, d => d.Id == \"CS8785\" || d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error);\n        Assert.Contains(\n            appRunResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources),\n            s => s.HintName.Contains(\"GeneratedMessagePackResolver\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n    }\n\n    private static async Task<ImmutableArray<MetadataReference>> GetMetadataReferencesAsync()\n    {\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> frameworkReferences = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        return frameworkReferences.AddRange(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n    }\n\n    private static CSharpCompilation CreateCompilation(string assemblyName, string source, ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> references)\n    {\n        return CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            assemblyName,\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n    }\n\n    private static MetadataReference EmitToMetadataReference(Compilation compilation)\n    {\n        using var stream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = compilation.Emit(stream);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n        return MetadataReference.CreateFromImage(stream.ToArray());\n    }\n}\n"}
